description: Restore the original directory tree from a repomix-packed output file — the single merged file repomix produces from a codebase, in XML, Markdown, or JSON format. Detects which of the three formats the input is in, extracts every packed file back to its original relative path, creates parent directories as needed, and reports exactly how many files were restored — never silent success. Use when the user has a file described as "repomix output," "repomix-packed," a "merged codebase," or named like repomix-output.xml/.md/.json, and wants the individual files back as a real directory instead of one giant blob to scroll through. Also covers "unmix," "unpack," "restore," or "reverse" a repomix bundle, and requests to validate or list what's inside a repomix package before extracting it. Not for creating a repomix bundle, and not for generic archives like zip or tar — this skill's parsing logic is specific to repomix's own merged-file formats.
